summary: Firefox’s video rendering paths gained better HDR handling, including 10-bit R10G10B10A2 output for VpAutoHDR and support for full-range NV12 video using the BT.2100 PQ HDR color standard. Graphics-resource updates also reduce unnecessary texture creation during direct scanout, allow Linux DMA-BUF images to be locked without a GL context, and add fence handling for Android ImageReader. Together, these changes improve color accuracy and resource synchronization across video and compositor paths.
